title: Improvement and Civil Maintenance to Lighthouse tower and allied Buildings at Poompuhar Lighthouse under Chennai Directorate
summary: Two-cover percentage-rate e-tender for improvement and civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower and allied buildings at Poompuhar Lighthouse, Mayiladuthurai District, Tamil Nadu.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Poompuhar Lighthouse, Poompuhar, Mayiladuthurai District
sites.work: Improvement and civil maintenance to lighthouse tower and allied buildings

scope.item: Improvement and civil maintenance to lighthouse tower and allied buildings
BOQ item 51.01: Providing and fixing 18 mm thick granite gang saw cut, mirror polished, pre-moulded, machine cut for kitchen platforms, vanity counters etc. (unit corrected by corrigendum)

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. No tender fee. EMD by DD/FDR of nationalized/scheduled bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; EMD validity stated as three months (table) and 90 days (clause 1.2) from technical bid opening. EMD exempted for MSME/NSIC registered firms with valid certificate in relevant category.

period.completion: 06 (six) months from the date of handing over of site
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost; values updated at 7% simple interest per annum; completion certificates from officer not below Executive Engineer
Similar works: construction of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work, and repairs and civil maintenance of building
CA-certified average annual turnover on construction works at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution

Annexures: tender acceptance letter (II), unconditional bid undertaking (III), bid security declaration (IV), non-blacklisting affidavit (V), list of relatives in MoPSW/DGLL (VI), Make in India self-certification (VII)

corrigenda.change: BOQ item 51.01 (18 mm granite for kitchen platforms/vanity counters): unit of measurement changed from RM to Sq.M. All other terms unchanged.

notes: Only Section I (NIT) is included; no BOQ or detailed scope beyond the corrigendum item. Listing shows closing 2026-04-07 and opening 2026-04-08, but the NIT prints submission end 24.03.2026 and opening 25.03.2026; any extension corrigendum is not among the documents. Hindi text of clause 1.7 describes roof repair of power house and inspection quarters and improvement works at Kilakkarai lighthouse (copy-paste error); the English names Poompuhar. Directorate e-mail printed on corrigendum is a gmail address.
